latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — generate and burn in captions for videos, free of charge.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files (up to 500MB) and generate subtitle-burned videos at 1080p in ~30–60 seconds.
- No installation required — videos are rendered on remote GPU nodes and returned as downloadable MP4 files.
- Session and authentication handled automatically, including free anonymous token acquisition if needed.
- Supports common workflows: batch processing, iterative edits, and track preview in timeline.
- Assorted error handling, session state polling, and seamless chat-based user prompts.
